neighbours.label: a writer's first-person reference to their own earlier act of writing or naming ('what I called', 'I posted a', French 'j'ai'): the token right after the first-person author's verb; the same verbs with a third-person subject or a non-writing sense stay low
fire: Yesterday on the newsletter I posted a long essay about urban gardening.
That is roughly what I called the strong reading in my earlier article.
Dans ce billet, j'ai présenté une méthode plus simple pour les débutants.
Earlier this month I posted a detailed guide to restoring old chairs.
This is the effect I called selective memory in the second chapter.
Sur ce blog, j'ai écrit plusieurs articles sur la photographie.
Over the weekend I posted a brief update on the garden project.
Recall the distinction I called the soft constraint a few pages back.
quiet: Yesterday at the post office she mailed a long letter to her cousin.
That is roughly what the locals call the old mill by the river.
Dans ce village, les enfants jouent au football après l'école.
Earlier this month the club bought a new set of garden chairs.
This is the bird my grandfather called a thrush when I was young.
Sur cette plage, les touristes arrivent tôt le matin.
Over the weekend the farmer repaired the fence near the barn.
Recall the friend who phoned you a few weeks back about the car.
